name: Time-Variant Volume Rendering with Octrees
aliases: Time-Variant Volume Rendering with Octree Compression
definition: Rendering technique for time-variant volumes using octree compression to fit multiple timesteps into main memory, overcoming GPU memory and bus bandwidth limitations.
summary: Time-Variant Volume Rendering with Octrees enables interactive rendering of large time-series by compressing multiple timesteps into sparse octrees stored in CPU memory, exploiting temporal coherence to bypass GPU limits.
